Our methodology to establish and operate the Ministry’s centralized 24x7 SOC and MDR service is based on a phased delivery model proven on multi-year cybersecurity and infrastructure programs, including cybersecurity deployments up to 33 months and PKR 143M/178M scale, and federal-government cloud infrastructure delivery completed in 2025 [CAP-013][CAP-037][CAP-049][CAP-012]. TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd is ISO 27001 certified and will align SOC processes to an ISMS-driven operating model [CO-PROFILE].

Phase 1 – Discover & Design: We will baseline log sources across data centres and connected entities, define onboarding priorities, and agree SLAs (time to detect/triage/contain) and escalation paths. Architecture will cover SIEM for centralized ingestion/correlation and SOAR for orchestration, case management, and automated response.

Phase 2 – Build & Integrate: We will implement high-availability SIEM/SOAR, integrate identity, endpoint, network, and cloud telemetry, and develop detection use-cases mapped to the Ministry’s threat scenarios. We will enrich alerts with threat intelligence and operationalize proactive hunting cycles.

Phase 3 – Operate 24x7 MDR: We will staff a tiered L1/L2/L3 model with continuous monitoring, triage, containment coordination, and incident communications. Our delivery footprint includes an in-country support desk capability (Islamabad HQ with Lahore/Karachi presence) to sustain operations and stakeholder coordination [CO-PROFILE].

Phase 4 – Incident Readiness, VA & Reporting: We will deliver incident-response runbooks, forensic-readiness procedures, periodic vulnerability assessments, and executive/technical reporting.

Phase 5 – Knowledge Transfer: Capacity building will be embedded via runbook walkthroughs, joint investigations, and quarterly service reviews.

Mandatory gaps: our audited average annual turnover is PKR 900M (below PKR 1,200M) [CO-PROFILE]. Our library does not yet evidence CISSP/GIAC coverage across all tiers; we will address this through targeted hiring and/or certified subcontract resources prior to mobilization [CO-PROFILE].
